create_LlamaForSequenceClassification: create a LlamaForSequenceClassification model with LlamaConfig and optional quantization config for sequence-level embedding
build_LlamaForSequenceClassificationWith: build a LlamaForSequenceClassificationWithNormal_Weights model that applies weighted pooling using a multi-layer reward scoring network
run_forward_sequence_classification: run forward pass on LlamaForSequenceClassification to produce EmbeddingPoolerOutput with last-token hidden state scores
run_forward_reward_scoring: run forward pass on LlamaForSequenceClassificationWithNormal_Weights to compute reward scores via pooled logits multiplied by learned weights
load_weights_llama_reward: load pretrained weights into LlamaForSequenceClassification by delegating to LlamaForCausalLM.load_weights
